mute.mutedText: Muted {{until}}. The conversation stays visible and its unread messages still show up.
mute.text: Your phone will stop ringing for this conversation. It stays visible in your list, with its unread messages.

e2eMissing: ⚠️ Private key missing on this device. Log out and back in to turn on encryption.

delete.title: Delete this message?
delete.text: It will be deleted for everyone.

enc.noPrivateKey: 🔒 Encrypted, private key missing (log in again)
enc.noSenderKey: 🔒 Encrypted, sender has no public key
enc.noCopy: 🔒 Encrypted, no copy for this account

reply.failedTo: Your reply to {{name}} could not be sent: {{message}}
reply.failed: Your reply could not be sent: {{message}}

list.removeText: Messages exchanged with {{name}} will disappear on your side. {{name}} keeps their copy, and the conversation will come back if a new message arrives.
list.tip: Your messages are end-to-end encrypted: nobody but you and your friend can read them. Long press a conversation to remove it from your list. Add friends from Profile → My friends.
list.empty: No conversations. Open a friend's chat from their card or the My friends screen!

report.why: Why are you reporting this content?
report.sent: Your report has been sent. Our team handles it within 24 hours.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: You will no longer see their messages and content. You can unblock at any time from Profile → Blocked users.
